tasks.label: Go2 Gazebo simulation
tasks.command: echo 'Starting Go2 Gazebo simulation...'; source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source ~/go2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch go2_config gazebo.launch.py rviz:=true

tasks.label: Go2 Gazebo teleoperation
tasks.command: echo 'Starting Go2 Gazebo teleoperation...'; source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source ~/go2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run teleop_twist_keyboard teleop_twist_keyboard

tasks.label: MQTT server
tasks.command: echo 'Starting MQTT server...'; sudo systemctl start mosquitto

tasks.label: MQTT Adapter
tasks.command: echo 'Starting MQTT Adapter...'; source /opt/ros/humble/setup.bash && source ~/go2_ws/install/setup.bash && python3 "${workspaceFolder}/go2_robot_state_adapter.py" --ros-args -p robot_id:=go2_001 -p publish_rate_hz:=20.0 -p mqtt_broker:=127.0.0.1 -p mqtt_port:=1883 -p mqtt_topic:=go2/vehicle_state

tasks.label: HLA gateway
tasks.command: echo 'Starting HLA gateway...'; export RTI_HOME="${workspaceFolder}/../../portico-2.1.4" && export RTI_RID_FILE="${workspaceFolder}/RTI.rid" && export _JAVA_OPTIONS="-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true" && python3 "${workspaceFolder}/hla_gateway_receiver.py"

tasks.label: HLA viewer
tasks.command: echo 'Starting HLA gateway...'; export RTI_HOME="${workspaceFolder}/../../portico-2.1.4" && export RTI_RID_FILE="${workspaceFolder}/RTI.rid" && export _JAVA_OPTIONS="-Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true" && python3 "${workspaceFolder}/hla_viewer.py"
